name: identity-workforce-session-readiness
objective: Create one canonical independent Field-provider lifecycle across Identity, Workforce and Control Panel, eliminating provisioning duplication and unifying activation readiness/session trust.
truthOwner: Identity owns actor/auth/session; Workforce owns independent-provider profile and activation eligibility; Control Panel is an authorized operator surface only.

tasks.objective: Replace all competing Field provisioning/readiness/profile paths with one canonical lifecycle.
tasks.currentProblem: Field is contracted as an independent provider but current UI/contracts still permit employee semantics; create UI points to a deprecated controller, provisioning-cases coexist with direct creation, POST semantics disagree about actorId, detail views are duplicated, and activation readiness is computed by multiple policies.
tasks.requiredChange: Make `/workforce/field-agents` the sole public create command; Workforce orchestrates Identity internally and persists the Field profile idempotently; remove public provisioning-cases/dead controllers/employee-only fields/shift drift; require service zone and supervisor before activation; unify readiness to name+phone+zone+supervisor+verified identity+approved contract; keep guarantor/referral policy-driven; converge one canonical provider detail/media/ops/activation UI; preserve single-use surface-bound activation and limited self-edit.
tasks.targetState: Operator creates one independent Field provider by business input without pre-created actorId, completes one canonical profile, reviewer approves required identity/contract evidence, activation is issued only when the single readiness policy passes, phone login/session work, and suspend/terminate/revoke fail closed everywhere.
tasks.action: Trace contracts, server routes/service/repository, Identity client, all Workforce frontend controllers and Control Panel HR routes/views; implement the single orchestration transaction/saga and idempotency; migrate/remove obsolete APIs/types/controllers/views; wire documents/save/supervisor/operational profile; add creation/replay/rollback/readiness/activation/session/suspension/object-isolation tests.
mustNotChange: Field لا يصبح employee ولا يملك shift.
لا public actorId prerequisite للمسار النهائي.
لا مسار إنشاء ثانٍ أو controller deprecated متبقٍ.
لا إصدار activation قبل readiness أو UI-only gate.
لا hard delete لمقدم خدمة تاريخي.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Field command واحدة idempotent تنشئ/تربط Identity وتكتب Workforce atomically/compensatably.
Supervisor/zone/identity/contract تظهر وتُحفظ وتدخل readiness واحدة.
تبويب media/profile/ops/activation يعمل من view canonical واحدة ولا duplicate view dead path.
phone login + single-use activation + session restore/logout/revoke pass on Android.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix trust/orchestration defects; never restore a competing provisioning API or weaken activation policy.
tasks.commitBoundary: Identity/Workforce/Control Panel Field-provider lifecycle as one coherent root-cause batch.
